title: Transformation of Chemically Competent Cells
author: NUS iGEM
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8achsaw

steps.title: Add DNA to competent cells
steps.instruction: Add either 1 µL of miniprep plasmid or 5 µL of Gibson product into competent cells.

steps.title: Heat shock cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells in a 42 °C water bath for 45 seconds.

steps.title: Chill cells on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells on ice for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Recover cells in LB media
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of LB media into the cell sample and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of LB media to the sample

steps.title: Concentrate cells
steps.instruction: Spin down the cells at 6000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove 700 µL of the supernatant from the tube.

steps.title: Plate the culture
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the culture onto an agar plate containing the appropriate antibiotic.
